profile.headline: Solver
profile.summary:
Software Designer and Developer with experience in a large number of technologies. Special interest in interactive applications like Game Development. But also experienced in more slow paced interactive development of Web Sites. Particular interest in GreenTech, Visual Design, and Artificial Intelligence applications.

Credits: Gears of War: Reloaded (2025), Tiny Tina's Wonderlands (2022), Borderlands 3(2019), Oculus Dreamdeck(2016), Avengers Initiative (2012), Disney Guilty Party (2010), Texas Cheat'em (2009), Hedronism (2008), Shards (2008), You Don't Know Jack: 5th Dementia (2000), You Don't Know Jack (1999), You Don't Know Jack: Offline (1999)

Specialties: Software Optimization, Project Management, User Interface Design, Object Oriented Design, Systems Design, Tutoring, Multimedia, Web Site Design, Database Design.

Programming: Advanced C++, Python, C#, HTML, SQL, and more.
